definitions.explanation: Actively promoting or driving forward a plan, policy, project, or initiative. Common in business, government, and organizational contexts.
The physical force that drives a vehicle, vessel, or rocket forward. A technical term used in engineering and aerospace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{推進|すいしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦デジタル{化|か}→デジタル化：08829_dejitaruka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{推進|すいしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
Used as both a noun and a suru verb. Sense 1 (promotion/advancement) is far more common in everyday use, appearing frequently in news and business. Sense 2 (propulsion) is technical. The word conveys active, sustained effort to move something forward.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {推進|すいしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to promote, to advance
- {推進|すいしん}⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧: driving force, promoter
- {推進|すいしん}{力|りょく}: driving force; propulsive power
- {推進|すいしん}⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧: promotion committee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{促進|そくしん}→促進：05632_sokushin⟧: promotion, acceleration (emphasizes speeding things up)
- ⟦{振興|しんこう}→振興：00471_shinkou⟧: promotion, development (of industry or culture)
